visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three young men sit at a light wood table against a plain grey wall. The middle man wears a black and white striped shirt and a silver necklace; the man on the left is in a dark grey t-shirt; the man on the right wears a black t-shirt. A bowl of noodles with green coriander flakes is on the table. One man uses chopsticks to lift a clump of noodles. (2) A hand enters the frame holding a green bag of coriander-flavored Doritos, placing it in front of the middle man. (3) Close-up shot on a wooden surface showing green triangular corn chips in a bowl. A hand picks one up to show the dark green speckled texture. (4) Back to the group, the man on the right smells the open bag of chips while the others watch his reaction. (5) The middle man eats a chip and immediately reacts with a look of intense disgust, squinting his eyes and pulling back. Red and orange fire graphics appear behind them to emphasize the reaction. (6) The men continue to discuss the chips while holding them; the lighting is bright and even studio light. (7) A close-up shows a hand sprinkling crushed green coriander-flavored chips into a paper bowl of noodles. (8) All three men are now eating from their own individual bowls of noodles with the crushed chips. They look much happier, smiling and giving thumbs-up gestures. (9) The man on the left continues eating heartily with a large spoon while the other two laugh and point at him.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A clean, minimalist studio background with a solid grey/off-white wall and a light wood-textured table.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Energetic electronic BGM with a steady 4/4 kick drum starts. A male voice introduces the scene with a bright, professional tone. (2) Sound of a plastic bag rustling loudly. Multiple male voices vocalize surprise and curiosity in a high-arousal chorus. (3) A sharp, crisp crunch sound indicates the chips are being eaten. Vocals switch to a rapid-fire conversational speed with significant pitch variability as they describe the scent. (4) A sudden, exaggerated vocal sound of disgust ("Ugh!") is followed by loud, high-valence group laughter. (5) Transition to the sound of slurping noodles and liquid splashing gently. The male voices become calmer but remain friendly and humorous. (6) Laughter becomes more frequent and intense. One speaker's voice has a playful, authoritative tone as he explains the uses of the product. (7) Final phase features continuous background chatter, the sound of a spoon hitting a bowl, and one voice speaking through mouthfuls of food, ending with a collective burst of laughter.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Introduction -> Product Tease -> Solo Taste Test -> Mixed Dish Test -> Final Verdict/Reaction
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a comedic food challenge and review of a specific snack (coriander-flavored Doritos). The creators test the product's flavor on its own—yielding a comedic negative reaction—and then test it as a topping for traditional noodles, which they find surprisingly enjoyable.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Clear visual display of the product bag, logo, and active testing of the flavor profile.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses fast-paced editing and variety-show style text overlays to maintain high engagement.
